method: Opened the seven chapter reference targets and inspected relevant passages. Reused previously verified individual official sign captions/artwork with hash checks; this is not a claim that all individual sign pages were fetched again.

sources.finding: Official catalogue identifies sign families, signals, markings, police directions and guards. Retained approved individual caption/asset bindings; each placed example links to its own official description.

Chapter 3 §§3–15 supports steady vehicle indications, amber unsafe-stop exception, flashing amber, lane control and separate public-transport scope. Chapter 2 and marking captions retain the verified source-register meanings.

Current chapter 2 §§2–4 supports precedence. Chapter 3 §§5,7,9–11,14–20 supports yielding, lane choice, line restrictions, safe speed, defaults and keeping junctions clear. Chapter 9 §1 motorway defaults retained. Future unrelated amendments not applied.
Catalogue confirms supplementary panels give distance, extent, time and other qualifications. Exact official poster vectors retain reviewed minimum dimensions; no invented assembly.
Speed-and-impact guidance explains increased impact severity and shorter stopping distance at lower speed. No copied graphic or numerical injury model used.

VTI report 980, hosted by Transportstyrelsen, sections 4.2–4.3 supports reaction plus braking distance and the shared available friction for braking/steering. The 50/3.6 and 80/3.6 examples are explicitly hypothetical unit conversions, not braking predictions.
TSFS 2011:20 chapters 2–3 supports observation, margins, prediction, consequence assessment and reflection.

G3_sources.title: Safe stopping distance
G3_sources.version: Live guidance; publication date not displayed in inspected passage
G3_sources.locator: Working out your crash avoidance space, steps 1–3; video transcript general-rule explanation
G3_sources.excerpt: count how long it takes you to pass the same object as the vehicle in front of you
G3_sources.supports: Select a fixed roadside point; count three seconds between lead vehicle and own vehicle passing it; increase margins for poor conditions.
G3_sources.fallback_reason: Exact fixed-point/counting instruction not located in targeted TS/TRV or Swedish-agency searches. Trafikverket-hosted NESTA and tunnel reports mention a three-second guideline but do not teach the counting method. Official NSW guidance supplies the exact technique.
G3_sources.scope_limits: Technique only. Three seconds is presented as a guideline, not a Swedish statutory interval or universal guarantee. Australian reaction-time assumptions, long-vehicle laws, penalty rules and left-side placement instructions are not imported.
G3_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary page retrieved and inspected

G3_sources.publisher: Department for Infrastructure / Driver & Vehicle Agency, Northern Ireland government
G3_sources.title: Taxi Driver Manual
G3_sources.excerpt: gradually reduce your speed to increase the gap between you and any vehicle ahead
G3_sources.supports: When followed too closely, gradually enlarge the forward gap to allow gentler braking and reduce rear-impact risk.
G3_sources.fallback_reason: Exact increase-forward-gap/gentler-braking behavioural instruction not located in inspected TS/TRV material. This government manual provides the explicit causal advice.
G3_sources.scope_limits: Common defensive-driving advice only, not Northern Ireland taxi law. Risk reduction is not a guarantee; necessary emergency braking remains necessary. Its two-second target is not imported.
G3_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary PDF retrieved and inspected

G3_sources.title: KRAV Grundvärden, Vägar och gators utformning (VGU)
G3_sources.version: TRV publication 2024:148, version 1.0; recognised by current Trafikverket VGU overview as part of current framework
G3_sources.locator: Printed p.9(58): braking-distance equation and variable definitions
G3_sources.supports: S_b = (V1² − V2²) / [2g(f_b + i)]; setting final speed to zero and holding denominator constant establishes the speed-squared braking-distance relationship.
G3_sources.scope_limits: Original mathematical derivation from agency equation. Hold grip/braking deceleration and gradient constant; real design friction can depend on speed. No general promise of exact fourfold road-test distance or fourfold total stopping distance.
G3_sources.retrieval_method: Complete indexed primary-PDF equation passage retrieved through search. Direct PDF opens timed out; no local source download or checksum claimed.

G3_swedish_rule_check.publisher: Swedish Government; published by Sveriges riksdag
G3_swedish_rule_check.excerpt: Avståndet till ett framförvarande fordon skall anpassas
G3_swedish_rule_check.finding: The general Swedish following-distance duty requires adaptation to avoid rear collision on slowing/stopping, without specifying a fixed three-second interval.
